thread:
maria: Morning async standup — quick update: finished H1 content calendar and drafted the benchmark blog. Blocker: waiting on final latency/cost numbers from Ben to lock figures. Today: write social copy and finalize hero. @ben can you drop median/p99 latency and token cost for the bench variant? :pray:
ben: Pushed updated metrics to the dashboard: https://app.redwood/bench/123. Median 62ms, p99 220ms, approx $0.0018/token. CSV uploaded to #eng-releases.
deploy-bot: New artifact 1763474800-bench-report uploaded to /releases/bench-v2 (embargo until 2026-03-20T15:00Z).
maria: great, thanks. @leo can you produce hero image variants we can A/B?
leo: Shared 3 Figma variants: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Will export hero-1.png and hero-2.webp by EOD and drop a zip.
sam: Distribution question — recommend: blog + 8-tweet thread + 30s demo gif. Thoughts?
ashley: Legal request: avoid definitive absolute claims until we finalize A/B. Use "median"/"up to" phrasing. Need 48h review on copy. Also confirm CTA goes to /benchmarks not /pricing.
maria: noted — draft uses "median latency" and links to /benchmarks. Also need a minimal curl/SDK code example for the blog — @ben can you paste one?
ben: sure — snippet to use: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-bench-v2","prompt":"Hello"}'
```
maria: perfect, I’ll wrap that with syntax highlight. Legal blocker still pending — @ashley any ETA?
ashley: Legal said 24–48h; I’ve pinged them. If no signoff by EOD tomorrow we move publish to Thu.
sam: I’ll prep the tweet thread and Buffer drafts but hold publish. Will also compile influencer list.
leo: Exported hero assets and uploaded: https://files.redwood/assets/hero-v2.zip
maria: checklist for go: blog draft, hero assets, bench CSV link, code snippet, legal ok, schedule. I’ll update the calendar and the launch doc. Thanks all :rocket:
ben: FYI opened PR #452 to add benchmark metadata to /benchmarks endpoint; link will be stable after merge.
maria: ack — will point to PR preview for now and swap to canonical when merged.
sam: small ask: include two tweet-copy variants (technical + marketing) so I can tweak tone. :+1:
maria: will add both variants. End of standup.
